Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, You can contact us: By email: havenlink.org@gmail.com August 3, 2026 Asad Sadikov and Aarav Gupta HavenLink Dear Asad and Aarav, On behalf of the City of Orlando, it is my honor to congratulate you both on the growth and impact of HavenLink. Your efforts to help connect prospective adoptive families, licensed agencies and organizations is certainly worthy of recognition and our community’s collective praise. What you have been able to accomplish through HavenLink reflects your commitment, intellectual curiosity and countless hours of hard work. Of course, your kindness and compassion should be commended as well. In Orlando, we believe that the future belongs to innovators, problem-solvers and critical thinkers. We’re impressed that you are already helping our community tackle complex challenges. You have set an outstanding example for your peers and brought immense pride to your family, your teachers and our entire community. Please accept my gratitude. I wish you continued impact with HavenLink and success on your academic journey. I also look forward to seeing the incredible contributions you will undoubtedly make in the years ahead. Sincerely, Buddy Dyer, Mayor Whereas, HavenLink is a free civic technology platform founded in 2025 by students at Trinity Preparatory School in Winter Park to provide prospective adoptive parents with a guided path from their first questions through the day a child comes home, while connecting families directly with licensed adoption agencies; and Whereas, HavenLink has remained completely free for every family it serves and has assisted more than 2,350 families by connecting them with licensed adoption agencies throughout 40 states and 22 countries; and Whereas, HavenLink collaborates with more than 65 licensed adoption agencies and has established partnerships with UNICEF and the Florida Department of Children and Families, demonstrating the far-reaching impact of a locally founded initiative; and Whereas, HavenLink is led by Technical Director Asad Sadikov and Nontechnical Director Aarav Gupta, whose vision, leadership, and commitment have transformed a high school project into a nationally recognized platform that continues to serve families seeking to build loving and permanent homes through adoption; and Whereas, HavenLink has strengthened awareness of adoption by engaging with local governments, state legislative offices, community organizations, and the media, while promoting access to reliable adoption resources and advocating for families across Florida and beyond; and Whereas, The work of HavenLink has been recognized by WFTV Channel 9, FOX 35 Orlando, and the Orlando Sentinel, highlighting the organization’s innovation, service, and dedication to improving access to adoption information; and Whereas, Florida is home to more than 20,000 children in foster care, and organizations like HavenLink play an important role in helping prospective adoptive parents navigate the adoption process by providing trusted, accessible guidance at no cost; and Whereas, The City of Orlando proudly recognizes young leaders whose innovation, compassion, and civic engagement strengthen our community and inspire others to create meaningful solutions to complex challenges; Now, therefore, I, Commissioner Shan Rose, by virtue of the authority vested in me, do hereby proclaim September 14 through September 20, 2026 “HavenLink Week” in the City of Orlando. In witness whereof, I hereunto have set my hand and caused the Seal of the City of Orlando to be affixed this 15th day of September 2026. Shan Rose Commissioner Office of Commissioner Tom Keen August 8, 2026 Aarav Gupta & Asad Sadikov Trinity Preparatory School 5700 Trinity Prep Ln Winter Park, FL 32792 Dear Mr. Gupta & Mr. Sadikov It is with great admiration that I recognize HavenLink for its innovative work helping prospective adoptive families navigate what can often be an overwhelming process. HavenLink demonstrates an extraordinary level of initiative mixed with civic responsibility. You created a practical solution: a free platform that provides prospective adoptive parents with a clear starting point and connects them directly with licensed adoption agencies—without charging families for the service. HavenLink has grown into a network connecting families with more than 30 licensed adoption agencies across 32 states and five countries, presented before city councils throughout Central Florida, and met with state legislators to raise awareness about adoption resources and the need to make reliable information easier for families to find. Your efforts have attracted significant public attention, including coverage from WFTV Channel 9, FOX 35 Orlando, Spectrum News 13, and the Orlando Sentinel. The accomplishments of HavenLink are a remarkable example of what young people can achieve when they combine technology, empathy, entrepreneurship, and a genuine desire to serve their community. HavenLink deserves recognition not only for the platform it has created, but for the example you are setting for your peers. Your initiative is helping make the adoption journey clearer and more accessible for families while bringing greater attention to an issue that deserves thoughtful community support. With sincere appreciation and recognition, Commissioner Tom Keen Aarav Gupta and Asad Sadikov RE: HavenLink Dear Mr. Gupta and Mr. Sadikov, In advance of National Adoption Month in November, and I want to thank you for identifying a real gap in our community and building something to close it. HavenLink at havenlink.org is an incredibly helpful resource that helps prospective adoptive parents understand where to begin the process and connects them directly with licensed adoption agencies. There are children in Florida waiting for permanent homes, and there are families here who would step forward if the path were clearer. I am grateful that you identified this problem, and that you took action to solve it. Accessibility and lack of knowledge are two of the biggest barriers to more people considering adoption, and you have made it immensely more easy for people to take that first step toward exploring the possibility. I am looking forward to seeing how you grow this resource in the years to come. Gratefully, Megan C. Sladek Mayor of Oviedo Whereas, HavenLink is a free civic technology platform, founded by students at Trinity Preparatory School in Winter Park, that guides prospective adoptive parents from their first question through the day a child comes home; and Whereas, HavenLink has never charged a family for its services and has served more than 2,000 families, connecting them with licensed adoption agencies; and Whereas, HavenLink works with more than 30 licensed adoption agencies across 32 states and five countries; and Whereas, HavenLink holds partnerships with UNICEF and the Florida Department of Children and Families, recognition rarely extended to an organization founded by high school students; and Whereas, HavenLink is led by co-founders Asad Sadikov and Aarav Gupta, who built and continue to run a working national platform while still in high school; and Whereas, HavenLink has carried this work into the public square, presenting to city councils across Central Florida, briefing state legislative offices, and publishing a newsletter on adoption policy; and Whereas, The work of HavenLink has been recognized by WFTV Channel 9, FOX 35 Orlando, and Spectrum News 13, and the Orlando Sentinel published commentary from the organization on July 22, 2026; and Whereas, Florida has more than 20,000 children in foster care, and clear information about adoption became harder for residents to find after House Bill 1083 closed public photo listings on July 1, 2024, making the free guidance HavenLink offers more valuable to families than ever; and Whereas, The founders of HavenLink have given their time to this work without compensation and have kept the platform free to every family who uses it; Now, therefore, I, Kelli Marks, Mayor of the City of Orange City, and on behalf of the City Council, do hereby recognize HavenLink for their contributions to the community. In witness whereof, I have hereunto set my hand and caused the Official Seal of the City of Orange City to be affixed on this day, August 25, 2026. Kelli Marks, Mayor September 4, 2026 Dear Mr. Sadikov and Mr. Gupta: It is my pleasure to congratulate HavenLink on its third anniversary! I applaud you for creating a national platform that connects newly prospective families with licensed adoption agencies across 40 states and 22 countries daily. Even more impressive, HavenLink is locally grown by students with a mission to connect families with licensed adoption agencies and help them find the resources and support they need to grow their families. This remarkable achievement demonstrates the power of young people to turn an idea into a meaningful reality. Congratulations on serving more than 2,300 families by connecting them with licensed adoption agencies. Thank you for the vital work you are doing and the positive impact it has on families’ lives. On behalf of the 1.6 million residents of Orange County, I congratulate you on this important milestone and all you have achieved so far. I wish HavenLink continued growth, success, and an even greater impact in the years to come. Once again, congratulations on your third anniversary, and best wishes for continued success! Sincerely, Jerry L. Demings Orange County Mayor September 28, 2026 Mr. Aarav Gupta and Mr. Asad Sadikov Co-Founder & Technical Director HavenLink Dear Mr. Gupta and Mr. Sadikov: On behalf of all Floridians, it is my honor to congratulate HavenLink on celebrating your remarkable milestone of serving more than 2,400 prospective adoptive parents. You have served your community, and I applaud your commitment to meeting the needs of Florida families. Organizations like yours are what make our state so great, and your work to step up when your fellow Floridians are in need is part of what makes our state so remarkable. As your United States Senator, I continue fighting to create a better life for Florida families so every Floridian, no matter how they grow up, has the opportunity to get a good job, receive a quality education, and raise their family in a safe community. My goal is to continue building on Florida’s tremendous success so every Florida family can live their American dream. I am incredibly proud of our state’s success, and none of it would be possible without dedicated organizations like HavenLink. Organizations like yours not only help those in need, but also strengthen the fabric of our communities and helps our state thrive. Congratulations again on your accomplishments, and thank you for your service to your community and our state. Florida is truly the best state in the nation to live the American dream, and that is in part due to amazing people like you. You have my best wishes for many more years of continued success in serving Florida families. Sincerely, Rick Scott United States Senator Resolution of the Seminole County Board of County Commissioners Recognizing the Achievements of HavenLink Whereas, HavenLink connects families directly with licensed adoption agencies and has always remained completely free for every family it serves, ensuring accessibility regardless of financial background; and Whereas, the founders launched HavenLink in response to a challenge often expressed by prospective adoptive parents—that the hardest part of adoption is not their willingness, but simply knowing where to begin—and HavenLink works to close this gap for families in Seminole County and far beyond; and Whereas, the platform has helped families throughout Central Florida, including here in Seminole County, and its reach now extends across numerous states and several countries through a growing network of licensed adoption agencies and partnerships with UNICEF and the Florida Department of Children and Families; and Whereas, alongside developing the platform, the founders have presented at multiple city councils and met with state senators, raising awareness and supporting legislation designed to make adoption more accessible and less burdensome for families; and Whereas, HavenLink streamlines the adoption process into an intuitive, easy-to-use format that reduces confusion, encourages participation, and helps ensure that children across Florida who are waiting for permanent homes can be connected with families eager to welcome them; and Whereas, the achievements of HavenLink have received widespread public recognition, including coverage by WFTV Channel 9, FOX 35 Orlando, the Orlando Sentinel, and Spectrum News 13, further demonstrating the platform’s impact on adoption awareness and accessibility; and Whereas, the initiative, innovation, and dedication shown by these two high school founders reflect the highest ideals of civic engagement and highlight the meaningful contributions young leaders are making within Seminole County and beyond. Now, therefore, be it resolved that the Seminole County Board of County Commissioners hereby honors and commends HavenLink for its outstanding achievements, its service to families across Central Florida and around the world, and its commitment to making adoption more accessible for all. Adopted this 13th day of October 2026 Andria Herr, Chairman Seminole County Board of County Commissioners

Everything becomes the document that carries your family to the next step. The readiness check 02 - 03

You're ready for the next step!

Since your home study is already complete, you can move straight to Step 2: the Family Intake Form. We've sent your home study details to HavenLink so the team has them on file. Your home study may need an update It was completed more than 24 months ago, and most states require updates every 12-24 months. Your agency can tell you whether a renewal is needed. Continue to Family Intake Form → Before we get started, which state do you currently live in? Home study requirements differ by state, so we'll tailor the rest of the questions to where you live. Select your state… Please select your state to continue. Yes No Please select an answer to continue.

For families living outside the United States

Home studies for international residents must be conducted through a USCIS-accredited agency in your country of residence. Please visit uscis.gov/adoption for guidance.

Great news - you appear to meet the basic requirements!

Based on your answers, you appear to meet the basic eligibility requirements for a home study in [State]. We've sent your results to HavenLink - one of our partners will reach out at your account email to walk you through next steps and help schedule your consultation. In the meantime, the preparation resources below will help you get ready for the interview, the paperwork, and the home visit.

Your state or agency may ask for more - confirm the final list with the provider conducting your study. 01 Interview Preparation The home study interview is a guided conversation. Your evaluator's goal is to understand your family and readiness to adopt. The primary applicant(s) and all adults in the home are interviewed, and sometimes older children too.

title: Home Study Service - HavenLink
content:
Common topics across all states

Why you want to adopt and what led you to this decision Your upbringing and family background Your parenting philosophy and approach to discipline Relationship history (for couples: how you communicate and handle conflict) Your support system - friends, family, community What age range or background of child you're open to How you plan to support a child's cultural or racial identity (if adopting transracially) Your understanding of trauma, loss, and attachment

Tips for answering well

Be honest - evaluators are trained to recognize rehearsed answers You don't need to be perfect; you need to show you're self-aware and prepared It's okay to say "we're still learning about that" Disagreeing with your partner on some things is fine and normal

What NOT to worry about

A small home, modest income, or imperfect past does not automatically disqualify you. The process is designed to rule families in, not out.

After the interview

The professional conducting your study writes up their report, and you may be asked to address specific items. Approval timelines vary by state and agency, and commonly take several weeks to a few months. 02 Documentation Checklist This checklist covers documents required in most states. Your state or agency may require additional items - check with the provider conducting your study for a complete list. Your progress is saved on this device.

Identity & Legal

Valid government-issued photo ID - all adults in household Birth certificate - all household members Social Security card - all adults Marriage certificate (if married) Divorce decree(s) (if previously married) Proof of legal name change (if applicable)

Financial

Federal tax returns - most recent 2 years Pay stubs or proof of income - most recent 3 months Bank statements - most recent 3 months General summary of assets (home, vehicles, investments) General summary of debts (mortgage, loans) Proof of health insurance coverage

Medical

Completed physical exam for all adults (within the past 12 months) Physician statement confirming physical and mental fitness to parent Immunization records for all household members Mental health clearance (if requested by agency)

Background & Legal Clearance

State-level criminal background check - all adults (specific agency varies by state) FBI fingerprint-based background check - check if required in your state State child abuse registry clearance (required in most states)

Home

Proof of homeownership or current lease Homeowner's or renter's insurance Pet vaccination records (if applicable)

title: Home Study Service - HavenLink
content:
References

3-5 personal reference letters (non-relatives preferred) - number varies by state and agency Reference contact information (name, relationship, phone, email)

Additional (varies by agency or state)

Vehicle registration and insurance Life insurance policy documentation (if applicable) Military discharge papers DD-214 (if veteran) Pre-adoption training certificate (required in some states) Autobiographical statement (required by many agencies) 03 Prepare Your Home During the home visit, the professional conducting your study confirms in person that your home is safe and has adequate space. Home safety standards are similar across most states, though some states have stricter rules for items like pools. Your progress is saved on this device.

Throughout the home

Working smoke detector on every floor - batteries tested Working carbon monoxide detector on every floor Fire extinguisher accessible (one per floor recommended) Emergency exit plan visible or discussed Unused electrical outlets covered with safety caps No exposed wiring or broken outlets

Kitchen

Cleaning products stored in a locked cabinet or out of reach Knives stored safely (drawer or knife block, not loose on countertops) Medications not stored in the kitchen

Bathrooms

All medications locked away or out of reach Water heater set to 120°F or below to prevent scalding Toilet locks if infant or toddler placement is anticipated

Bedrooms

Child's designated sleeping area identified - appropriate bed or crib No couch, hallway floor, or shared adult bed as the primary sleeping arrangement Window guards installed if above ground floor (for young children)

Garage / Storage / Outdoors

Chemicals, paints, and fuels in a locked cabinet or shed Tools stored safely Pool or hot tub fenced with a self-latching gate (California: must meet CA Swimming Pool Safety Act) Firearms unloaded, in a locked safe, with ammunition stored separately

Tips for the visit itself

Cleanliness matters but perfection doesn't - a clean, organized home demonstrates care Offer a walkthrough proactively; don't wait for your evaluator to ask Be present and relaxed - the visit is a conversation, not an inspection If you spot something that needs fixing, fix it before the visit rather than explaining it away

After the visit

Your evaluator writes their findings into a report. If any items need attention, you'll be notified and given time to address them before final approval.
